mentions.name: AlgoMommy
mentions.description: AlgoMommy is a macOS app that helps users organize video clips prior to editing in Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and similar editors. It replaces the manual, time-consuming process of filing newly recorded clips (e.g. CLIP_5213.mp4) into a sensible folder hierarchy (e.g. Wedding/B-Rolls, Wedding/Reception), so users can focus on creating content. The app uses WhisperKit and Apple Intelligence SpeechAnalyzer for offline transcription.
mentions.problem: Filing newly recorded video clips into a folder hierarchy by hand is manual and time-consuming.
mentions.audience: Video creators preparing footage for editing in tools like Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm soon to beta my first macOS app: AlgoMommy. AlgoMommy helps you organize your video clips prior to editing them in Final Cut Pro / DaVinci Resolve / etc.
